title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O – Finance and Costing Manager
description:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations – Finance and Costing Manager** to join our Customer Success team. This role is crucial in ensuring the efficiency, accuracy, and compliance of financial operations and costing practices in D365 F&O. You will collaborate with clients, functional teams, technical teams and developers to provide expert support, drive solutions, and improve financial process outcomes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, budgeting, tax, cost management and cost accounting functions within D365 F&O, helping clients streamline their operations and achieve operational excellence.

**Important - This role requires working in US hours to support clients effectively.**

***Working hours: 3rd Shift (5:00 PM - 2:00 AM IST)***

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert support and consulting for D365 F&O Finance modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Tax, Cost Management and Cost Accounting.
* Provide priority support for high severity cases identifying options to get past the initial issue and deliver the necessary long-term solution. Collaborate with internal teams and clients as needed for deliver root cause analysis for these cases.
* Monitor and respond to incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
* Evaluate reported issues to identify where they stem from and work with the necessary team to resolve. This includes but is not limited to customer specific code, Crowe Metals Accelerator (CMA) and Microsoft functionalities.
* Prepare/maintain support documentation, configuration guides and process documentation.
* Support implementation of enhancements through the full software development life cycle, hotfixes and service updates.
* Support period-end/year-end business activities.
* Design and configure financial processes including intercompany, consolidation, month-end close, and financial reporting.
* Guide clients on best practices for configuration/processes and internal controls within D365 F&O.
* Continuous self-learning of new features/functionality/technologies as well as guiding younger team members on their cases/career.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Charted Accountant.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with D365 F&O
* Strong understanding of D365 F&O functionalities related to financial management and costing.
* Microsoft certifications in D365 Finance (preferred).
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail and collaborative teamwork abilities.

* Clear, confident English communication – comfortable engaging directly with U.S. counterparts during the alternate shift.
* Ability to manage multiple client expectations and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with localization and compliance requirements (e.g., tax configurations, regulatory reports)
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Exposure to project accounting and multi-entity finance implementations
* CPA/CMA or MBA in Finance a strong plus.

What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe: Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

title: Finance Executive
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts & Taxation Executive to manage our day-to-day accounting and statutory compliance. You will own GST and TDS filings, maintain accurate books of accounts, prepare tax computations, and support management with cash flow, funds flow and budgeting inputs. The ideal candidate is comfortable with deadlines, strong with numbers, and keeps up with changes in Indian tax law.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. GST Compliance

* Prepare and file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and other periodic returns (GSTR-9/9C annual return and reconciliation, where applicable) within due dates.
* Reconcile books with GSTR-2A/2B to ensure accurate input tax credit (ITC) claims.
* Handle e-invoicing, e-way bill generation, and GST-related notices or queries in coordination with consultants.
* Maintain GST ledgers and ensure correct tax rates, HSN/SAC codes, and place-of-supply treatment.

2. TDS / TCS Compliance

* Calculate, deduct, and deposit TDS correctly under applicable sections (salary, contractor, professional fees, rent, etc.).
* Prepare and file quarterly TDS returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q) and issue Form 16 / 16A.
* Reconcile TDS data, rectify defaults, and respond to TRACES notices or correction statements.

3. Book-keeping & Accounting

* Record daily transactions: sales, purchases, receipts, payments, journal entries, and bank entries.
* Perform bank, vendor, and customer reconciliations; track receivables and payables.
* Maintain fixed asset register and depreciation schedules.
* Complete month-end and year-end closing, including provisions and accruals.
* Assist with preparation of financial statements and coordinate with statutory and internal auditors.

4. Cash Flow & Funds Flow Statements

* Prepare cash flow statements (as per AS-3 / Ind AS 7) and funds flow statements.
* Monitor weekly and monthly cash positions and flag liquidity shortfalls.
* Provide working-capital analysis to support management decisions.

5. Budgeting & MIS

* Assist in preparing annual budgets, forecasts, and variance analysis.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports comparing actuals against budget with brief commentary.
* Track departmental expenses and highlight deviations.

6. Other Accounting Duties

* Process vendor payments, payroll inputs, and expense reimbursements.
* Handle ROC, PF/ESI, and Professional Tax compliance support, where applicable.
* Maintain organised records and documentation for audits and assessments.
* Support ad-hoc requests from management, auditors, and tax consultants.

**Qualifications**

* B.Com / M.Com required; CA Inter, CMA, or MBA (Finance) preferred.
* More than 5 years of experience in accounting and indirect/direct tax compliance.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Tally Prime, Zoho Books, SAP, or similar accounting software.
* Working knowledge of GST portal, TRACES, and the Income Tax e-filing portal.
* Advanced MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliations).
* Sound understanding of Indian GAAP / Ind AS basics.

**Soft Skills**

* High accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong time management and ability to meet statutory deadlines.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Integrity and confidentiality in handling financial data.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to keep learning as regulations change.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Secondary(10th Pass) (Preferred)

Experience:

* Account analysis: 5 years (Required)

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**

We’re looking for people who:

* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them

**Job Description:**

**Job Title - FP&A Analyst**

**Experience - 5–7 years**

**Location - Hybrid**

**Role - Third Party Payrolls**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The FP&A Analyst will own budgeting, forecasting, actuals reporting and variance analysis for assigned Engineering, IT and non-engineering cost centers and projects. The role also supports month-end closing activities, headcount reporting, project finance (WBS, capitalization, Workday Projects) and ad-hoc / scenario-based analysis for India leadership (SMT), Engineering Directors and global finance teams. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented and comfortable working in Workday Adaptive Planning, SAP and advanced Excel to deliver accurate, timely and well-explained numbers.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Budgeting & Forecasting**

Prepare annual budgets and monthly forecasts for assigned cost centers and projects; load them into the planning system; run scenario analysis.

**Variance Analysis**

Analyze actuals vs budget, prior forecast and prior year (monthly and YTD), with bridges and clear commentary.

**Headcount Reporting**

Consolidate and report headcount; align with approved positions and budget; reconcile to cost centers.

**Month-End Close**

Support month-end close, including journal entries, accruals and reconciliations, in coordination with the accounting team.

**Project Finance & Capitalization**

Set up WBS projects in SAP; monitor AUCs and quarterly releases to Fixed Assets; run amortization simulations; support Workday Projects (budget setup, resource and project loading, labor-rate tie-outs); reconcile Workday Projects to SAP; support mid-year project labor absorption and cap rates; maintain the Plan of Record (POR) repository for NPD/NFD projects.

**Reporting & Ad-hoc Analysis**

Prepare management reporting packages and dashboards; deliver ad-hoc and business case analysis for leadership.

**Controls & Documentation**

Keep reconciliations and audit support current; maintain process documentation.

**RECURRING DELIVERABLES**

**Month-end close & journals**

Accurate, on-time close support

**Actuals & variance reporting**

Variances vs budget, prior forecast, prior year

**Forecast & headcount reporting**

Forecast load and headcount reconciliation/ reporting BU wise

**Project reporting & reconciliations**

Project actuals, variances, bridges; Workday Projects-to-SAP reconciliations and tie-outs; WD Project Systems forecast

**WBS project set-up & AUC monitoring**

SAP WBS set-up; AUC monitoring and releases to Fixed Assets

**Budget preparation & scenarios**

Annual budget load and scenario analysis

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

**Experience**

5–7 years in FP&A, business finance or financial analysis, ideally in a corporate / captive / GCC environment with budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis ownership

**Must have**

**Education**

Bachelor's in Commerce, Finance or Accounting; MBA, CA, CMA or CFA preferred

**Excel & modeling**

Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, SUMIFS, multi-tab models); strong variance, bridge and scenario modeling skills

**Planning tools**

Hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar EPM tool) for forecast and budget loads

**ERP / finance systems**

Working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO, WBS / project systems, fixed assets); exposure to month-end close and journal entries

**Communication**

Explains variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders

**BI / dashboards**

Power BI or Tableau

**Good to have**

**Headcount & cost center analysis**

Experience with HC planning, reporting and reconciliation

**Workday Projects**

Experience with Workday Projects set-up and reconciliation

**Capitalization & amortization**

Familiarity with AUC, capitalization and amortization simulations

**BI / dashboards**

Power BI or Tableau for dashboards and reporting

**Communication**

Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain variances to non-finance leaders and global teams

**Working style**

Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, self-starter, comfortable with multiple recurring cycles and ad-hoc requests

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Accurate, on-time close, forecast and budget deliverables.
* Clear variance commentary and clean reconciliations.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and audit readiness.

Pitney Bowes (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
The role requires strong financial analysis, structured thinking and an interest in startups, emerging sectors and technology\-enabled businesses.

Key ResponsibilitiesInvestment Evaluation

* Review pitch decks, business plans, financial statements and fundraising proposals.
* Conduct preliminary screening of investment opportunities.
* Assess business models, revenue drivers, unit economics, market potential and scalability.
* Evaluate the strength of the founding team, competitive position and principal business risks.
* Prepare screening notes and recommendations for the investment team.
* Maintain an organised pipeline of prospective investments.

Financial Modelling and Valuation

* Build and review integrated financial models for startups and growth\-stage companies.
* Analyse historical performance and management projections.
* Develop revenue, cost, cash\-flow and funding requirement forecasts.
* Perform valuation using appropriate methods, including discounted cash flow, comparable companies, precedent transactions and venture\-capital methods.
* Prepare dilution, ownership and capitalisation\-table analyses.
* Calculate investor returns under different financing and exit scenarios.
* Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis on key assumptions.
* Clearly distinguish management assumptions from independently developed estimates.

Commercial and Market Research

* Research industries, market size, growth trends and competitive dynamics.
* Evaluate total addressable, serviceable and obtainable markets.
* Analyse customer segments, pricing, distribution and market\-entry strategies.
* Benchmark target companies against relevant competitors and comparable businesses.
* Identify regulatory, technological and macroeconomic factors affecting an investment.
* Prepare concise sector notes and market maps.

Due Diligence

* Support financial, commercial and operational due diligence.
* Review financial statements, management information, bank records and tax information.
* Examine revenue quality, customer concentration, gross margins, working capital and cash burn.
* Test key operating assumptions against available evidence.
* Identify inconsistencies, missing information and potential risks.
* Maintain due\-diligence request lists and document trackers.
* Coordinate with legal, tax, technical and industry advisers.
* Summarise findings and unresolved matters for the investment team.

Investment Committee Support

* Prepare investment memoranda, valuation summaries and presentation materials.
* Present analytical findings clearly to senior investment professionals.
* Support the preparation of investment\-committee meetings.
* Document key assumptions, risks, mitigations and return scenarios.
* Incorporate feedback and update analysis as new information becomes available.
* Maintain appropriate records of investment decisions and supporting analysis.

Transaction Support

* Assist with term\-sheet analysis and transaction structuring.
* Model pre\-money and post\-money valuations, liquidation preferences, anti\-dilution provisions and employee\-option pools.
* Analyse the effect of convertible instruments and future funding rounds.
* Support management reference checks and stakeholder discussions.
* Coordinate transaction documentation and closing requirements with relevant teams.
* Verify that final economic terms are reflected accurately in the financial model.

Portfolio Monitoring

* Collect and analyse monthly or quarterly portfolio\-company reports.
* Track revenue, margins, cash burn, runway and operating performance.
* Compare actual results with budgets and investment\-case assumptions.
* Monitor fundraising requirements, milestones and material risks.
* Maintain portfolio valuation and performance records.
* Prepare portfolio\-review reports for management and investors.
* Flag performance concerns and funding needs promptly.

Fund and Investor Reporting

* Support fund\-level performance analysis and reporting.
* Assist with calculations of invested capital, fair value, realised returns and unrealised returns.
* Calculate and monitor metrics such as IRR, MOIC, DPI, RVPI and TVPI.
* Reconcile portfolio and fund data with finance and administration records.
* Prepare analysis for investor reports and internal management reviews.
* Maintain confidentiality of investor, portfolio and transaction information.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, Engineering or a related discipline.
* MBA in Finance, Chartered Accountant qualification, CFA programme participation or a comparable qualification is preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance and valuation.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Strong written and spoken English.

Experience

* Approximately 1–4 years of relevant experience.
* Experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, transaction advisory, equity research, corporate finance or financial modelling is preferred.
* Experience analysing startups or growth\-stage companies would be advantageous.
* Candidates with strong internship experience in investment analysis may also be considered.

Key Skills

* Financial modelling and forecasting
* Business valuation
* Financial\-statement analysis
* Market and competitive research
* Startup unit\-economics analysis
* Capitalisation\-table and dilution analysis
* Due diligence
* Investment memorandum preparation
* Scenario and sensitivity analysis
* Portfolio\-performance monitoring
* Strong numerical and analytical ability
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines

Personal Attributes

* Intellectually curious and commercially aware
* Able to evaluate both opportunities and risks objectively
* Comfortable working with incomplete information
* Willing to question unsupported assumptions
* Highly organised and attentive to detail
* Ethical and discreet
* Proactive and dependable
* Interested in entrepreneurship and emerging business models
* Able to work effectively in a small, fast\-paced investment team

Key Performance Indicators

* Quality and accuracy of financial models
* Timeliness of investment screening and due diligence
* Quality of investment memoranda and presentations
* Accuracy of valuation and return analyses
* Identification of material investment risks
* Completeness of transaction documentation
* Timeliness and accuracy of portfolio reporting
* Maintenance of investment\-pipeline information
* Responsiveness to investment\-team requirements
* Compliance with confidentiality and internal review standards

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated résumé
* Brief note explaining their interest in venture capital
* Sample financial model or investment analysis, where available
* Current and expected compensation
* Notice period
* Current location
